STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_11092_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_11092_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11092 (
	     DATA_OUT, FULL, EMPTY,
	     CLK, RESETn, DATA_IN, PUSH, POP
	     );

   parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8;               
   parameter ADDR_EXP   = 12;                
   parameter ADDR_DEPTH = 4096;    
   
   input CLK;                           
   input RESETn;                         
   input [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] DATA_IN;    
   input PUSH;       
   input POP;        

   output [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] DATA_OUT;  
   output FULL;      
   output EMPTY;     

   reg EMPTY;
   reg FULL;

   reg [DATA_WIDTH -1:0] memory[0:ADDR_DEPTH-1];   
   reg [ADDR_EXP -1:0] write_ptr;                
   reg [ADDR_EXP -1:0] read_ptr;                 
   
   reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] DATA_OUT;          
   reg [ADDR_EXP -1:0] next_write_ptr;    
   reg [ADDR_EXP -1:0] next_read_ptr;     
   wire accept_write;      
   wire accept_read;       

   always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
     if (!RESETn) begin
        next_write_ptr <= 0;      
        next_read_ptr <= 0;    
     end else begin
        if (accept_write) next_write_ptr <= write_ptr + 1;      
        if (accept_read) next_read_ptr <= read_ptr + 1;    
     end
   end

   assign accept_write = (PUSH && !FULL) || (PUSH && POP);
   assign accept_read = (POP && !EMPTY) || (PUSH && POP);

   always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
     if (!RESETn) begin
        write_ptr <= 0;       
     end else begin
         if (accept_write) begin
            write_ptr <= next_write_ptr;            
         end
     end
   end

   always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
     if (!RESETn) begin
        read_ptr <= 0;        
     end else begin
         if (accept_read) begin
            read_ptr <= next_read_ptr;              
         end
     end
   end

   always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
     if (!RESETn) begin
        EMPTY <= 1;  
     end else begin
         if (EMPTY && accept_write) begin
            EMPTY <= 0;          
         end
         if (accept_read && (next_read_ptr == write_ptr)) begin
            EMPTY <= 1;          
         end
      end
   end

   always @(posedge CLK or negedge RESETn) begin
     if (!RESETn) begin
        FULL <= 0;   
     end else begin
         if (accept_write && (next_write_ptr == read_ptr)) begin
            FULL <= 1;
         end else if (FULL && accept_read) begin
            FULL <= 0;              
         end
     end
   end

   always @(posedge CLK) begin
      if (accept_write) begin
         memory[write_ptr] <= DATA_IN;           
      end
      if (accept_read) begin
         DATA_OUT <= memory[read_ptr];
      end
   end
   
endmodule
